segment.description: Little West Fork Creek — a stream on the Fort Campbell military reservation in Montgomery County, Tennessee (catalog; HUC 05130206; the creek's basin also extends into Christian County, Kentucky on the post). It is one of the post's stocked trout streams under CAM Regulation 200-4. The post-wide 2026 program runs February through August, supplied by KDFWR (Feb/Apr) and TWRA (Jun-Aug).
segment.boundaries: The stocked reach(s) of Little West Fork Creek on the Fort Campbell reservation (catalog GNIS 00499492, 01291707); stocking events are published post-wide under 'Fort Campbell Streams' (TWRA, Montgomery Co.) and by KDFWR for the Kentucky-side reaches.

coldSource.notes: No cold-source documentation found; no gage or temperature record located for the creek.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. The post's trout program is put-and-take with recurring February-August stockings (TWRA workbook: 'Fort Campbell Streams', Montgomery Co., Seasonal weekly-of 2/15/2026 through 8/23/2026, rainbow; iSportsman: KDFWR events Feb 12 and Apr 7, TWRA events Jun 25, Jul 22, Aug 26, 2026). KDFWR's February 2026 stocking record for the Kentucky side names 'Fort Campbell (Little West Fork Creek)' at ~960 trout (surfaced via WebSearch snippet of fw.ky.gov's stocking archive; exact archive URL unresolved — noted, not cited). No source documents survival between stockings. The catalog's programmatic seasonMonths (12,1,2) conflicts with the documented 2026 pattern (documented stocking months are February-August).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found; the fishery is a stocked put-and-take program on a military reservation under CAM Regulation 200-4, with a state fishing license plus post permit requirements.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Put-and-take post stream restocked with rainbow (and brown) trout about monthly February through August 2026 under the Fort Campbell program, with no evidence of survival between stockings or outside the stocked season.
